RoomType.rationale: SlimedBerserkerNormal declares RoomType.Monster; the sim's bucket-membership counterpart agrees (slimed_berserker only in normal_keys).

AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: Single-element superset on both sides, identical to the actual roster (fixed composition, nothing else can spawn here). Same reasoning as encounter/owl_magistrate: the sim has no per-encounter AllPossibleMonsters concept, but a fixed-composition encounter cannot diverge on it.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: One monster, no slot tag (null both sides), zero RNG draws either side. Roster/order/draw-count all match trivially.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.maps_to: the Encounter dataclass (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) is never registered as a hook listener; only Monster instances register themselves
ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: Same structural fact as every other unit in this batch: the sim's Encounter object has no hook methods and is never passed to HookSystem.register.

guards.what: MinGoldReward/MaxGoldReward -- not overridden, inherits the Monster ladder (10-20) x Poverty multiplier
guards.rationale: sts2_rl/rewards.py GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.MONSTER] = (10, 20) and SLIMED_BERSERKER_NORMAL sets neither min_gold nor max_gold -- matches. Poverty/ascension scaling is out of scope per PROMPT.md and not modelled by rewards.py (documented in its own module docstring), so not filed as a gap.

guards.what: ShouldGiveRewards / IsWeak -- neither overridden, both default (true / false)
guards.rationale: Encounter.should_give_rewards defaults True and is unset here; slimed_berserker appears only in normal_keys, never weak_keys, matching the inherited IsWeak=false.
